intro: The passive with ser, the passive with se, and the difference between fue cerrado and está cerrado.
p.fue construido.consejo: «Ser» + participle. The participle agrees with the subject: «el puente fue construido», «la casa fue construida».
p.fue escrita.consejo: It is feminine because the subject is «la novela». The participle of «escribir» is «escrito», not «escribido».
p.han sido contratados.consejo: With «han» you need «sido»: «han sido contratados». It agrees with the plural subject.
p.se encontró.consejo: It is the everyday passive. It does not say who did it: «se encontró un cuadro».
p.está cerrado.consejo: With «estar» it is a state, not an action: «la tienda está cerrada». The action would be «fue cerrada».
p.puente.consejo: It is masculine: «el puente». The «ue» sounds «we»: PWEN-te.
p.siglo.consejo: A century has a hundred years. You say «el siglo pasado» or «hace un siglo».
p.cuadro.consejo: It also means square. «Un cuadro de Goya» is a painting by Goya.
p.restaurar.consejo: You restore a painting or a building. Participle: «restaurado» (el cuadro fue restaurado).
p.contratar.consejo: The company hires a person. Participle: «contratado», for the passive.
p.participio.consejo: It ends in -ado or -ido: «construido», «cerrado». In the passive it agrees with the subject.
p.pasiva.consejo: In «el puente fue construido», the bridge receives the action. It belongs to formal texts and the press.
b1.texto:
**Ser + participle** is the full passive. The participle agrees with the subject, and **por** brings in the doer: la novela **fue escrita por** Cervantes. Los guías **han sido contratados**. It belongs mostly to the press, history and formal writing.

**Se + verb** is the passive people use every day. It has no doer: **se construyó** en 1900; **se vendieron** todas las entradas.

In speech, the object can simply go first, with a pronoun to repeat it: el puente **lo construyeron** los romanos.

**Estar + participle** is not an action. It is the state that results: la tienda **fue cerrada** a las ocho (someone closed it); la tienda **está cerrada** (that is how it is now).

The person who receives something cannot be a passive subject. «Me dieron un libro», not «fui dado un libro».
b2.f0.texto: This painting was restored last year.
b2.f2.texto: It was painted by Goya around 1800.
b2.f3.texto: Yesterday another painting was found in the basement.
b2.f4.texto: Two new guides have been hired by the museum.
b2.f5.texto: The museum is closed on Mondays.
b2.f6.texto: Outside, the bridge was built a century ago.
b2.f7.texto: That novel about the bridge was written by a neighbour.
b4.texto:
- **ser + participle**: el puente fue construido por los romanos (written, with the doer)
- **se + verb**: el puente se construyó en el siglo I (no doer, any register)
- **object first + lo / la**: el puente lo construyeron los romanos (spoken)
- **estar + participle**: el puente está cerrado (the resulting state)

The participle agrees with the subject: construido, construida, construidos, construidas.
b4.e0.texto: The bridge was built by the Romans.
b5.f0.texto: The old bridge crosses the river with three arches of pale stone.
b5.f1.texto: It was built a century ago by hands that nobody remembers any more.
b5.f2.texto: The light of dawn gilds the stones worn down by time.
b5.f3.texto: Under the arches, the water speaks in a low voice with the shadows.
b5.f4.texto: A cool wind smells of wet grass and distant smoke.
b5.f5.texto: Not long ago, the bridge was restored with patience and care.
b5.f6.texto: The walls were cleaned with soft brushes.
b5.f7.texto: Now a wooden sign tells its story to passers-by.
b5.f8.texto: At dusk, the bridge is full of light and calm footsteps.
b5.f9.texto: At night, the bridge is closed and sleeps under the moon.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «novela» is feminine and «escribir» has the participle «escrito».
b6.o1.refuerzo: It is masculine. «Novela» needs the feminine form: «escrita».
b6.o2.refuerzo: That form does not exist: «escribir» has an irregular participle.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Here the doer does appear: «los romanos».
b7.pregunta: Which form does not say who did the action?
b8.frase: Dos personas han sido contratadas por la empresa
b8.traduccion: Two people have been hired by the company
b9.o0: el momento en que alguien la cerró
b9.o0.refuerzo: That is what «fue cerrada» would express.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done: «estar» + participle is the result.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It mentions nobody: it only describes the state.
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «the bridge was built».
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «entradas» is plural, so the verb is too.
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is singular, but «todas las entradas» is plural.
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is a participle. After «se» you need a conjugated verb.
b12.o0.refuerzo: The receiver cannot be the subject of the passive in Spanish.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Neither: Spanish does not make the receiver the subject.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Correct: the receiver is «me», the indirect object.
b12.pregunta: How does Spanish say «I was given a book»?
p.restaurado.consejo: Participle of «restaurar», to restore. The au is a diphthong.
p.pintado.consejo: Participle of «pintar», to paint. Stress on TA: pin-TA-do.
p.sótano.consejo: Masculine, «el sótano». Stress on SO: SO-ta-no.
p.guías.consejo: Plural of «guía», guide. The g is hard, and the stress is on GI.
p.romanos.consejo: Plural of «romano», Roman. Stress on MA: ro-MA-nos.
p.vendieron.consejo: Past tense of «vender», to sell. The v sounds like b: ben-DIE-ron.
p.arcos.consejo: Plural of «arco», arch. Stress on AR: AR-kos.
p.desgastadas.consejo: Feminine plural of «desgastado», worn. Stress on TA.
p.limpiaron.consejo: Past tense of «limpiar», to clean. The ia is a diphthong.
p.muros.consejo: Plural of «muro», a thick wall. Stress on MU: MU-ros.
p.cepillos.consejo: Plural of «cepillo», brush. The c before e is th and the ll sounds like y.
p.paseantes.consejo: Plural of «paseante», someone out for a walk. Stress on AN.
p.escrita.consejo: Feminine participle of «escribir», to write. Stress on KRI.
p.verbo.consejo: Masculine, «el verbo». The v sounds like b: BER-bo.
p.contratadas.consejo: Feminine plural of «contratado», hired. Stress on TA.
p.dieron.consejo: Past tense of «dar», to give. The ie is a diphthong: DIE-ron.
